source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Even after this **TRANSPORT** makes an **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, units can [disembark](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) from it. A unit that does is treated as if it made a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** in that phase, and it cannot declare a charge that turn, but otherwise acts normally.
